$Comment: Lumber the Sawmill handed over, rung 1 of the sawmill_lumber ladder. Target 'Wood_' on PREFIX catches every species and every cut the mill makes: base yield, the tool-ladder bonus and any find alike. One rung of a ladder: Listing.Chains names the ladder and this rung's place in it, and every rung shares ONE FlavorKey whose {0} is filled from TextArgs.Flavor's @amount, so retuning a rung is editing its Amount and nothing in a language file. Every STATION_OUTPUT criterion carries Qualifier 'Sawmill', so only what this station hands over counts.
